messages:
Taylor Morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. We need to lock the comms approach: statuspage language, RCA sharing cadence, and how recurring flaps trigger customer email alerts. Tracker: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-199/tracker :link:

ops-bot: Postmortem uploaded by @Taylor Morgan: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-199/postmortem :page_facing_up:

Priya Desai: For statuspage labeling, proposal: use 'Degraded performance' for localized latency or errors below threshold; use 'Service disruption' when user-facing errors >1% or >p95 SLA breaches for >10m. Keeps language consistent across incidents.

Lucas Fernandes: Agree. For RCA sharing: publish a short customer summary (redacted) within 72h by default; if incident is single-owner and low blast radius, target 48h. Full technical RCA available on request under NDA in 10 business days.

Taylor Morgan: Ok — let's codify that in the incident template. Also need decision on who signs off redactions. Current default: Security + Incident Owner + Legal. Can we allow Security to sign off low-risk internal-data redactions alone?

Priya Desai: I'd rather keep tri-signoff for external-facing docs to be safe. For non-customer internal summaries, Security can approve. We should add an 'exceptions' checkbox in the tracker with justification.

Lucas Fernandes: We'll also want a recurring-incident tag and weekly digest for patterns. I'll own the pattern analysis (A4) and add a scheduled job. Cron snippet: "0 7 * * 1 /srv/bin/incident_patterns --incident INC-2026-199 --window 30d --out /tmp/inc199.json"

Taylor Morgan: Action owners: A1 - statuspage copy: Priya to finalize (due 2026-06-04); A2 - template SLA fields & RCA_sharing_policy: Taylor to update template; A3 - redaction approval flow proposal: Lucas to draft + Legal review; A4 - recurring pattern analysis: Lucas to run weekly.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: A1 statuspage draft due 2026-06-04T09:00:00Z (owner: Priya Desai).

Priya Desai: I'll post two variants: a short blurb for statuspage and a 72h customer summary draft. Will tag Legal in the tracker for review.

Lucas Fernandes: I'll prototype an approval webhook so approvers can sign off in tracker (example payload: {"incident":"INC-2026-199","redaction":true,"approver":"security@redwood.com","approved":true}).

Taylor Morgan: Great. Let's keep comms consistent and make the template pick deadlines based on incident severity. Follow-up sync in 48h to confirm statuspage text and approval flow. :calendar:
